# Start Assist

Source: [4524](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4524); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Start Assist](../../api/actions/start-assist.md).

<a id="wiki-4524-n1"></a>

- Start Assist exposes Last Assist ID and fails when too many assists are active.

<a id="wiki-4524-n2"></a>

- Eliminated targets allied to assister give defensive assists; enemy targets give offensive assists; assisters/targets may reevaluate.

Source limitations:

- Description calls assist a damage modification and reevaluation type points to Chase Reevaluation; metadata likely copy errors.
